title: Service record
description: Canonical schema for a Service Insights service record (alpha). Derived from the service-record data dictionary. Human fields are entered by the service owner or their team; system fields are set by the store and are read-only. Records may not contain fields outside this schema (additionalProperties: false).

id.description: Unique identifier for the record. Set on creation, read-only.

name.description: Public-facing or working name of the service.

description.description: One or two sentences on what the service lets a user do.

type.description: Service type / channel. Under review — controlled values to be confirmed with the alpha team.

digitalServiceType.description: The type of digital service, for digital services.

owningOrganisation.description: Owning organisation within the Defra group.

owner.description: Named individual accountable for the service.

ownerEmail.description: Contact route for the named owner.

serviceContact.description: The service or delivery team's key contact. A single contact for alpha; multiple may be supported in beta.

name.description: Service or delivery team key contact.

type.description: The role held by the key contact, e.g. Delivery Manager.

lifecyclePhaseStartDate.description: The date the current lifecycle phase started.

lifecyclePhaseEndDate.description: The date the current lifecycle phase is expected to end. Must be on or after lifecyclePhaseStartDate (enforced by the store).

primaryUserGroupOther.description: Free-text user group when primaryUserGroup is 'other'.

sensitivity.description: Government Security Classification of this directory record. Governs what the renderer shows to unauthenticated viewers.

startPageUrl.description: Start or home page of the service. Required when lifecyclePhase is public_beta or live.

dataSensitivity.description: Highest classification of data the service handles. Distinct from the record's own sensitivity.

deliveryGroup.description: Delivery group the service belongs to.

platform.description: Hosting or delivery platform, for the estate view.

webRegisterId.description: Unique web register ID for the service. Background field.

projectOnlineCode.description: Unique Project Online code for the service. Background field.

sopCode.description: Unique SOP code for the service. Background field.

serviceNowId.description: Unique ServiceNow ID for the service. Background field.

relatedServices.description: Identifiers of related or predecessor services. Populated by the directory after registration.

updatedAt.description: When the record was last updated.

updatedBy.description: Identity of the last editor, as an email address or system principal.
